title: Cryptography Based on Square-Free Ideals and the SR Condition
content: In this work we introduce a new class of cryptographic primitives based on square-free ideals and the SR condition in commutative and noncommutative rings. We formalize the computational problems SQ IDEAL and SQ GEN, concerned respectively with recognizing square-free ideals and determining radical generators. We analyze their complexity, present interpretations in polynomial and matrix rings, and propose cryptographic schemes that use square-free decompositions and radical generators. The work represents a further step toward factorization-based cryptology grounded in the structure of elements and ideals.
